responsibility: Provides rustc’s incremental-compilation infrastructure: the crate root (`lib.rs`) assembles and exposes the compiler entry points for setting up an incremental session, loading reusable state, saving new dep-graph/query-cache/work-product results, and finalizing session directories; the `persist` module implements the persistence layer that defines and validates the on-disk incremental state, manages cache directories and artifact paths, publishes and cleans work products, and runs `#[rustc_clean]` checks; `assert_dep_graph.rs` supplies the testing and debugging machinery that verifies annotated dependency-graph edges and can dump dep-graph data for inspection; and `assert_module_sources.rs` supplies the testing pass that checks expected codegen-unit reuse or regeneration from `#[rustc_partition_*]` annotations. Together, these pieces let the compiler safely reuse prior compilation results across sessions while also providing the validation and diagnostics needed to test and debug incremental behavior.
